context_and_journey.proposed_scope: Proposed bounded deliverable — Secure engineering lifecycle: A release record links requirement and specification changes, reviewed code, dependency and licence inventory, security checks, migration results and approvers. Production promotion requires the declared gate evidence; unsupported dependencies receive an owned risk and resolution decision. context_and_journey.proposed_scope: Proposed bounded deliverable — Validation and quarantine: Validation classifies every input row as accepted insert, accepted update, unchanged duplicate, rejected, quarantined or unprocessed. Rejected rows carry safe field errors; raw input remains unchanged. Cancelled jobs identify committed rows and never claim full rollback. Retain the original acceptance: Load 100 rows with 90 valid, five duplicates and five invalid in partial mode; reconcile all 100 outcomes and retry only the corrected five.. Technical breakdown: Define insert/update/duplicate/rejected/quarantined/unprocessed outcomes and declared atomic/partial behavior. Use durable receipts and immutable raw batch; atomically commit nothing on blockers or reconcile eligible partial effects and cancelled commits. context_and_journey.proposed_scope: Proposed plan; no Ready or Done decision implied. Extend governed tenant activation/suspension/reactivation/closure preview with class-policy readiness, cancellation boundaries and hold-respecting exit. Complete retained source obligation: An operator creates a requested tenant with an owner invitation and selected policy profile. Activation checks verified owner, recovery contact, region, retention and identity settings. Suspension previews scheduled writes, then pauses them while preserving policy permitted support and exit access. Reactivation rechecks expired grants and source credentials; it does not replay queued writes automatically. Closure follows the exit workflow and cannot skip holds.

context_and_journey.proposed_scope: Proposed plan; no Ready or Done decision implied. No password or reset secret enters ordinary administration, telemetry or diagnostics. Complete retained source obligation: Local account setup displays the effective password policy, permits paste and password managers and checks known compromised values. Reset returns a neutral acknowledgement and a short lived single use recovery link. Successful reset revokes prior recovery tokens and sessions according to policy. Proposed reset expiry is 30 minutes. Never reveal whether a supplied address is registered. Apply bounded retry and abuse controls without exposing password text to telemetry or normal administrators.

context_and_journey.proposed_scope: Proposed full-story requirement: A deployment variant has a named capability profile, region and recovery constraints, responsibilities, upgrade process, key custody and exit process. Product screens show supported and unsupported features for that qualified profile. Dedicated deployment and customer controlled keys are not available merely by selecting a commercial checkbox. Each offered variant must pass equivalent functional, isolation and recovery gates. Preserve all original acceptance/rejection scenarios; this refinement records work and decisions, not Ready, implementation, or acceptance.
